## 🌐 Core Website Files (Required)

**The main website file - all content lives here**

**When to edit:**

## 🗂️ Assets Folder Structure (Create Yourself)

You need to create this folder structure:

```
assets/
└── projects/
    ├── creator-portfolio.jpg
    ├── thumbnail-campaign.jpg
    ├── startup-landing.jpg
    ├── restaurant-website.jpg
    ├── personal-brand.jpg
    └── youtube-intro.jpg
```

**Image Requirements:**
- Size: 600x400px (minimum)
- Format: JPG or PNG
- File size: < 150KB (use TinyPNG.com)
- Naming: lowercase-with-hyphens.jpg

2. Create assets/projects/ folder

4. Read QUICK_START.md

### Day 2: Customize
1. Edit script.js (contact info)
2. Edit index.html (pricing)
3. Edit projects.js (add your projects)
4. Add project images to assets/projects/
5. Test in browser

### Day 3: Refine
1. Edit reviews.js (add client reviews)
2. Customize content in index.html
3. Test on mobile
4. Test WhatsApp buttons
5. Check for broken images

### Day 4: Deploy
1. Create GitHub repository
2. Upload all files
3. Enable GitHub Pages
4. Share website link
5. Monitor analytics

## 📞 File Relationships

```
index.html (main file)
    ├── Loads: style.css (styling)
    ├── Loads: script.js (logic)
    ├── Loads: projects.js (portfolio data)
    └── Loads: reviews.js (testimonials)

script.js (logic)
    ├── Manages navigation
    ├── Renders projects (from projects.js)
    ├── Renders reviews (from reviews.js)
    ├── Handles forms
    └── Creates 3D scene

projects.js (data)
    └── Displayed by: script.js

reviews.js (data)
    └── Displayed by: script.js
```

**Key Point:** All the documentation files are optional (just for reference). The 5 core files (index.html, style.css, script.js, projects.js, reviews.js) are what makes the website work.

## 🆘 Emergency Quick Reference

**Website won't open?**
→ Make sure index.html is in root folder

**Images don't show?**
→ Check assets/projects/ folder exists
→ Check filename matches exactly

**WhatsApp not working?**
→ Check phone number in script.js
→ Try on mobile device

**Pricing not updated?**
→ Search "PRICING SECTION" in index.html
→ Change the numbers
→ Refresh browser (Ctrl+F5)

**Projects not appearing?**
→ Check projects.js is in root
→ Check image paths: "assets/projects/name.jpg"
→ Check for syntax errors (missing commas)

**Mobile looks broken?**
→ Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+Delete)
→ Try different browser
→ Check window size matches responsive breakpoints
